summary: Iteration 5 security-hardening verification for SEC-001/SEC-003/SEC-004 — 25/26 tests PASS, 1 SKIPPED (payment-unlock full round-trip; skip cause = seed data has no unpaid request with an already-initiated payment record — SEC verification not affected). (SEC-001) All three demo logins work: admin@taxman.manoj/Admin@123 (super_admin), staff@taxman.manoj/Staff@123 (accountant), demo@taxman.manoj/Demo@123 (client, TM-000001) — every /api/auth/login returns access_token + user. Staff perms sanity: view_clients+edit_clients+view_documents+approve_documents+download_documents+manage_accounting+manage_payments; NO view_reports, NO manage_tickets — matches review-request expectation exactly. (SEC-003) Global InvalidId exception handler in server.py L24-27 verified: GET /api/admin/clients/notanid -> 404, GET /api/client/requests/xyz123 -> 404, POST /api/admin/payments/badid/status -> 404. Bonus sweep across admin/clients/@@bad@@, admin/tickets/notanid, client/requests/!!bad!!, admin/payments/xxxxx/verify: none 500, all clean 400/403/404. (SEC-004) Accountant permission matrix VERIFIED: GET /api/admin/stats -> 403 (needs view_reports), GET /api/admin/audit -> 403 (admin-only), GET /api/admin/tickets -> 403 (needs manage_tickets), GET /api/admin/documents -> 200 (has view_documents), GET /api/admin/requests -> 200 (has view_clients). Admin (super_admin '*') regression: all five endpoints -> 200. Client (demo) RBAC regression: all five endpoints -> 403. (Prior fix regression) POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns clean 200 with no dev_otp/otp/6-digit code in body; register-purpose OTP cannot be used at /api/auth/reset-password (400 'This code cannot be used for this action.'). (Core regression) POST /api/client/requests with a service+business+FY 2019-20 (no assigned price) returns 402 'Price not assigned yet…' — server-authoritative pricing gate holds. Payment-unlock full flow (upload doc -> 402 -> admin mark received -> 200 with file_token) SKIPPED because no unpaid request in demo seed has an initiated payment record (invoice-only, payment doc not yet created via /client/payments/initiate); the pieces are individually covered (402 gate + admin set_payment_status wiring + file_token issuance) elsewhere.

minor.issue: None of the 6 payment_pending seeded requests for demo@taxman.manoj have an accompanying payment doc in /api/admin/payments (client hasn't initiated). This makes the end-to-end 'admin marks payment received -> unlock doc' round-trip skip in tests. Not a security fix regression; SEC-003/SEC-004 all verified. Consider seeding one payment_submitted request WITH a payment doc + one uploaded doc to enable full unlock coverage.

action_items: None blocking. OPTIONAL: enrich seed with a payment_submitted request that already has a payment doc + one uploaded document, so the full unlock round-trip test can pass (not skip). This is a coverage improvement, not a fix — SEC-003/SEC-004 are fully verified.
critical_code_review_comments: SEC-003 handler placement (server.py L24-27) is correct: registered on the FastAPI app before routers hit InvalidId at ObjectId(...) construction; returns a JSONResponse 404 {detail:'Resource not found'}. Verified against all three targeted routes and a wider sweep — no 500s slip through.

SEC-004 admin_api.py: /stats (L32-34) requires view_reports; /documents (L421-423) requires view_documents; /requests (L537-539) requires view_clients; /tickets (L678-680) requires manage_tickets; /audit (L785-790) restricts to super_admin/admin explicitly. All five gate correctly against the accountant seeded perms. Router-level Depends(require_staff) on the whole /api/admin prefix (L24) provides defense-in-depth against clients — verified.

SEC-001 (seed.py env-driven with demo defaults when SEED_DEMO_ACCOUNTS!=false): preview keeps demo creds so the app is still usable. Recommendation for production deploy: set SEED_DEMO_ACCOUNTS=false and provide SEED_ADMIN/STAFF/CLIENT_PASSWORD env vars, and rotate JWT_SECRET (currently in /app/backend/.env). Not a preview issue.

OTP purpose binding still holds end-to-end: register-purpose OTP -> reset-password returns 400 with the intended cross-purpose rejection. forgot-password body verified to contain neither dev_otp/otp nor any 6-digit substring — even in dev echo mode.
